Australia vs Japan delivered a THRILLER in the FINAL!
With Australia leading by 6 points with just 90 seconds left, Japan launched an INCREDIBLE comeback and turned the final into a nail-biting finish!
Japan fought all the way to the final buzzer, coming within just ONE POINT of completing the comeback in an unforgettable battle for the title!
